original_card.question: Can one measured replay bottleneck be sped up without dropping coverage?
methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Report before/after wall time on the same fixture, retained checks and invalidation behavior.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected reproduction command and choose a single replay stage for profiling.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Measure one unchanged fixture, preserve check coverage, and test one optimization with invalidation controls.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.
allowed_variations: Profile one stage or design one source-bound cache boundary.
scope_change_triggers: Skipping coverage or comparing different fixtures to claim speedup.

actual_scope: Can the production quadratic-affine rank witness (scripts/experiments/quadratic_affine.py:rank_witness, exercised by scripts/audit_quadratic_affine.py / certificates/quadratic-affine-vectors.json) adopt the exact base-256 packed-row algorithm from research/quadratic-affine-packed/ so the shipped verify-certificates path is faster while every orthogonality row, digest and receipt field stays identical?
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card asks for one measured replay bottleneck with before/after wall time and retained checks. Expertise override selected verifier-engineering after profiling make verify-certificates poles. Leave-alone objects (joint frames, shared-point, mixed-point verify, ternary frames, parity-side, leech_minor/affine_vector_screens, central-factor production, exclusion embedding residual, inplace compile-scan) were skipped. Curtis Dransfield's opt-in packed adapter (#752) already proved the algorithm; production still used the pairwise inner loop. Open #1076 targets the same hotspot with a different bit-sliced engine and remains partially reviewed; this session wires the incorporated #752 packed check into the shipped source and certificate pin.
bottleneck_link: Side result on review throughput: quadratic-affine-vectors is part of verify-certificates. A faster identical rank witness does not change kappa or the binding complex supplier.
stop_rule: Ship an equivalence-preserving production rank_witness change with frozen baseline, identical witness and audit payloads, rejection/temp-corruption controls, certificate pin discipline, registered replay and a measured before/after median. Do not invent kappa or reopen leave-alone objects.
evidence: PASS_QUADRATIC_AFFINE_PRODUCTION via research/quadratic-affine-production/verify.py (also under -O); PASS_IDENTICAL_QUADRATIC_AFFINE_PRODUCTION_RECEIPTS via benchmark.py; certificates/quadratic-affine-vectors.json differs from base only in the quadratic_affine.py source pin.
author: Wentao Li
